rationale: The assistant correctly identified pulsing as 'the vacuum's protection system kicking in because it can't get enough air' and led the customer through filter wash (cold water, 24h dry) then blockage checks, reaching the true cause (wand clump plus dirty filter) in three turns with no parts or escalation. It sensibly flagged that radiator drying 'can sometimes leave the core damp', though it did not explicitly tell the customer to keep the filter off direct heat and did not ask the model, filter history or body-alone test before issuing instructions. Minor weaknesses: assumed 'both filters (pre-motor and HEPA)' before the model was known, and the closing advice missed the obvious tip to wash the filter monthly given it had never been washed.
